summary.headline: Mankind Q1 FY27 revenue rose 12.9% YoY to INR4,031 crore and reported EBITDA margin expanded 250 bps to 26.3%, with PAT up 29.1% to INR574 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue grew 12.9% YoY to INR4,031 crore, led by BSV specialty and a 29% rise in international business. Domestic formulations (ex-Consumer Healthcare) grew 11% to INR3,180 crore, with chronic up 15.8% and acute recovering to 10.9% versus IPM. Margin expansion came from a 230 bps gross margin gain, with lower finance cost offset by a higher tax rate (25.4%). Management guided that gross margin will likely compress in coming quarters on commodity and dollar pressures, but kept full-year EBITDA guidance of 25.5% to 26.5%.

segments.name: Domestic business (incl. Consumer Healthcare)
segments.commentary: Revenue rose 10.5% YoY to INR3,426 crore, driven by chronic growth of 15.8%, acute recovery and double-digit BSV growth. Secondary sales per IQVIA grew 12.7% with volume growth of 4.7%.

segments.name: Domestic ex-Consumer Healthcare
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 11% YoY to INR3,180 crore. Chronic share ex-BSV rose 80 bps YoY to 40%, with cardiac up 19.4% and anti-diabetes up 12.7%.

segments.name: International
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 29% YoY to INR605 crore, with management citing US launches and currency tailwind of 12-13%.

segments.name: BSV (Bio Specialty Vertical)
segments.commentary: Grew about 21% in Q1 (domestic about 17%, international about 25%). Management guides high-teens growth for FY27 and a domestic-to-international split of roughly 51:49.

segments.name: Consumer Healthcare
segments.commentary: Revenue was INR246 crore, with growth of about 3.8%. Cash and carry sales were stopped, and modern trade and e-commerce share rose to 15% from 11%, growing 38%.

guidance_outlook: Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 25.5% to 26.5%.
Gross margin guided to be upward of 71% for FY27, with compression expected in the next quarter or so from higher commodity and dollar prices (West Asia cost pressure).
Domestic business expected to return to double-digit growth for the full year, with sequential improvement and chronic and acute both contributing.
BSV growth guided at high-teens for FY27.
Consumer Healthcare guided to high single-digit to double-digit growth from Q2 FY27 onwards.
Net operating working capital days expected to fall by year-end as inventory is rationalised.
Capex guided at 6% to 7% of revenue for FY27 (Q1 at 4.9%); R&D guided at 2.8% to 3% of sales for FY27 (Q1 at 2.4%).
Acquisition-related debt expected to be fully repaid by FY28; chronic share target of 50% over the medium term (4 to 5 years).
capex_capacity: Q1 FY27 capex INR198 crore (4.9% of revenue) vs INR127 crore in Q1 FY26; FY27 guidance 6% to 7% of revenue.
Hospital business market share still significantly below peers, cited as a long runway for growth.
Added a biotech facility and enhanced R&D biotech facility within BSV.
Partnered with Denovo Science on an AI-led drug discovery programme.
Launched a new division, Vistar, to scale lesser-focused brands from existing divisions.
demand_pricing: IPM secondary sales growth per IQVIA was 12.7% in Q1, with volume growth of 4.7% (up 220 bps YoY).
Acute growth recovered to 10.9% from 6.1% a year ago; gastro 13.6%, gynaecology 12.7% (IPM 12.1%), vitamins/VMN 19.3%, anti-infectives 3.6%.
Price increases taken contributed to gross margin expansion; management said the price benefit had not fully flowed through due to inventory levels.
New introductions contributed 2.8% of sales vs IPM 4.1% (IPM includes GLP-1s), indicating softer launch contribution.

GLP-1 (semaglutide) launched late in anti-diabetes and gynaecology amid price war with 20+ companies and 35-40 brands; management is avoiding a price war and pursuing a therapy-led approach with KOL promotion. No export strategy for it.

qa_highlights.question: How will the remaining nine months of India growth look, and will Mankind consistently outperform IPM?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said domestic has returned to double-digit growth with better quality (chronic 15.8%, acute 10.9%, volume 4.7%). It expects progressive outperformance from chronic mix, hospitals, new divisions and under-penetrated states, though it did not commit to a specific multiple of IPM.

qa_highlights.question: How will BSV grow this year?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1 BSV grew about 21% (domestic about 17%, international about 25%). Guidance is high-teens growth for FY27. Last year's growth was early teens, not 5-6%.

qa_highlights.question: Why will working capital stay elevated and will gross margins hold?
qa_highlights.answer: Inventory is slightly above normal, and management expects days to fall by year-end. Gross margin may compress in the next quarter from commodity and dollar pressures, but the 71%+ gross margin and 25.5%-26.5% EBITDA guidance were kept.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Consumer Healthcare growth slow, and what is the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Cash and carry sales were stopped because they hurt general trade. The market was softer. Modern trade and e-commerce grew 38% and reached 15% share. Guidance is high single-digit to double-digit growth from Q2.

qa_highlights.question: Why was Mankind cautious on launching GLP-1 (semaglutide), and what is the anti-diabetes covered-market story?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called it a strategic decision to avoid a crowded launch (20+ companies, 35-40 brands) and to focus on a therapy approach. Covered market in anti-diabetes rose from 56% in FY21 to 74% in FY26, and rank improved from 10 to 7 with a 4.5% share.

qa_highlights.question: What metrics show the reorganisation is working (attrition, share gains)?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said attrition and vacancies are back to normal after a sharp drop. Acute growth improved from 3.3% in Q2 FY26 to 10.9% in Q1 FY27, and chronic from 12.2% to 15.8% over the same period.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Rivotril (Roche) acquisition worth?
qa_highlights.answer: Rivotril's IQVIA sales are about INR20-30 crore. Management said growth depends on specialist access and that the CNS category takes time. It aspires to build a gold portfolio in CNS.

risks_watch: Gross margin pressure from commodity, dollar and West Asia-related costs in the next quarter; guidance floor is 71%.
Inventory-driven working capital (52 days) and cash flow to EBITDA falling to 77%; management expects normalisation by year-end.
Acute therapies (about 60% of the portfolio) are still recovering; anti-infectives are only 3.6% growth.
Higher effective tax rate (25.4%) following the Sikkim plant tax exemption expiry.
Late and selective GLP-1 launch in a price-war market; execution and share gain are unproven.
New launches contribute less than IPM (2.8% vs 4.1%).
Consumer Healthcare growth is slowing and depends on the Q2 onwards recovery.
Capex (4.9% of revenue) and R&D (2.4%) running below full-year guidance; watch for catch-up.
summary.management_tone: Confident on recovery and quality of growth, but measured on near-term margins and on the GLP-1 strategy. Management was defensive when asked why it lags IPM and why it is cautious on GLP-1 launches, and it did not commit to outperforming IPM.
key_quotes: Our disciplined execution and strengthening business fundamentals resulted in improvements across key operating and financial metrics in quarter 1 FY27
So definitely double-digit growth will come, in the times to come.
We're not in a hurry, but we feel that as every quarter would pass, things will improve.
It's not a cautious approach, it's a strategical approach.
